readme:
# TikTok Profile Scraper

Pass in a list of TikTok usernames, get back their public profile data. No login, no API key, no cookies. Just HTTP.

**Immune to API signature rotation.** Most TikTok scrapers call TikTok's signed JSON API - when TikTok rotates their X-Bogus / X-Gnarly signing keys (every few months), those scrapers go dark until their owners port the new algorithm. This one parses TikTok's server-rendered HTML instead, so the signing-rotation cycle doesn't take it offline. (Caveat: if TikTok ever changes the HTML rehydration schema or gates the HTML behind a JS challenge, that's a different break - we monitor and update. The point is it's structurally independent of the signing treadmill, not invulnerable.)

This actor returns **one item per profile** - not one per video. If you want clean, structured profile metadata for lead generation, panel research, or competitor tracking, this is the right tool. If you also want the profile's recent videos alongside its stats, set `maxVideosPerProfile` to a value between 1 and 30 (see "Recent videos" below). If you need full video timelines with tens of thousands of items per creator, use a dedicated video scraper.

## What you get

For every username you pass in, the scraper hits TikTok's public profile page and pulls the rehydration block - the same JSON the TikTok webapp uses to render the profile. About **18 fields per profile**, including:

- Stable user ID + secUid (survive username changes)
- Username, display name, bio, **link in bio**
- Follower / following / video counts
- Verified badge, private flag, TikTok Shop seller flag + category
- Account language and **account creation timestamp**
- High-resolution avatar URL
- Profile URL and scrape timestamp
- **Optionally: recent videos** - id, description, cover, engagement counters, publish date

If TikTok soft-blocks a proxy IP mid-run, the scraper rotates to a fresh session and retries the profile (up to `maxIPRotations` times, default 5). One bad IP doesn't kill the batch.

## Input

```json
{
  "profiles": ["charlidamelio", "khaby.lame", "mrbeast"]
}
```

Usernames can be plain (`charlidamelio`), at-prefixed (`@charlidamelio`), or full URLs (`https://www.tiktok.com/@charlidamelio`). All three normalize to the same thing.

### Available input fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `profiles` | array | required | Usernames, @handles, or profile URLs |
| `maxVideosPerProfile` | integer | 0 | How many recent videos to include per profile. 0 = profile-only (cheapest). 1-30 = fetch that many recent videos from the creator embed feed. See "Recent videos" section. |
| `maxIPRotations` | integer | 5 | How many times to retry a profile with a fresh session if TikTok soft-blocks the IP |
| `proxyConfiguration` | object | BUYPROXIES94952 | Apify proxy. Datacenter works fine - TikTok serves the public profile HTML over datacenter at our volumes. Switch to RESIDENTIAL only if datacenter is degraded for a specific run. |

## Output

One item per profile.

```json
{
  "username": "charlidamelio",
  "user_id": "5831967",
  "sec_uid": "MS4wLjABAAAA-VASjiXTh7wDDyXvjk10VFhMWUAoxr8bgfO1kAL1-9s",
  "display_name": "charli d'amelio",
  "bio": null,
  "bio_link": "https://youtube.com/@charlidamelio",
  "follower_count": 158300000,
  "following_count": 1394,
  "like_count": null,
  "video_count": 3154,
  "verified": true,
  "is_private": false,
  "is_seller": false,
  "commerce_category": null,
  "language": "en",
  "account_created_at": "2015-11-14T12:57:18Z",
  "avatar_url": "https://p16-common-sign.tiktokcdn-eu.com/tos-maliva-avt-0068/...",
  "profile_url": "https://www.tiktok.com/@charlidamelio",
  "scraped_at": "2026-06-12T06:13:15Z"
}
```

### A few notes about the fields

- `user_id` is the stable numeric ID. Use it as a primary key - TikTok usernames can change but IDs cannot.
- `bio_link` is the URL the creator placed in their bio (Linktree, YouTube, store, Instagram, etc.). Null when they haven't set one. **This is usually the most valuable field for lead generation.**
- `is_seller` + `commerce_category` flag TikTok Shop sellers. Filter on these to build a panel of creators with monetised shops.
- `account_created_at` is useful for trust scoring - brand-new accounts are higher risk for bot/spam analyses.
- `like_count` (total likes across all videos) is sometimes `null`. TikTok has been quietly removing this from the public profile payload for some accounts - when it's there we return it, when it isn't we set null instead of guessing.
- `follower_count`, `following_count`, `video_count` are integers, not the abbreviated "158.3M" strings you see on the page.
- `verified` is the blue check.
- `bio` is `null` if the profile has no bio set.
- `avatar_url` is the highest-resolution variant TikTok exposes (usually 1080x1080).

## Recent videos

Set `maxVideosPerProfile` to a value between 1 and 30 and the scraper appends a `recent_videos` array to each profile row. Videos are pulled from TikTok's public creator embed feed - the same feed the "embed profile" widget uses. No login, no signed API calls.

```json
{
  "profiles": ["duolingo"],
  "maxVideosPerProfile": 5
}
```

Response:

```json
{
  "username": "duolingo",
  "follower_count": 15400000,
  "video_count": 1200,
  "...": "...",
  "recent_videos": [
    {
      "video_id": "7663591047909379341",
      "video_url": "https://www.tiktok.com/@duolingo/video/7663591047909379341",
      "description": "@Tinder",
      "published_at": "2026-07-15T18:30:56Z",
      "view_count": 114800,
      "like_count": 1690,
      "comment_count": 368,
      "share_count": 93,
      "play_url": null,
      "duration_seconds": null,
      "cover_url": "https://p16-common-sign.tiktokcdn-eu.com/..."
    }
  ]
}
```

### Recent-videos caveats

- **Cap is TikTok's, not ours.** TikTok's creator embed ships 10-12 videos per profile. Any `maxVideosPerProfile` above that returns whatever the embed surfaces (typically 10-12).
- **`play_url` and `duration_seconds` are usually null.** TikTok strips direct playback URLs and duration metadata from public embed pages. If you need those, you need a signed-API video scraper. These fields are kept in the schema for forward compatibility.
- **View counts are approximate.** TikTok reports rounded values on some feeds (e.g. 100000 → 102600 → 100000 across refreshes). Use them as scale indicators, not exact analytics.
- **Extra requests, extra pricing.** Each video counts as one extra fetch (creator embed + one per-video embed). That's why the default is 0 - leave it at 0 unless you actually need videos.

## Examples

**Single profile, no videos**
```json
{"profiles": ["charlidamelio"]}
```

**Profile plus recent videos**
```json
{
  "profiles": ["duolingo"],
  "maxVideosPerProfile": 10
}
```

**Mixed input formats**
```json
{
  "profiles": [
    "charlidamelio",
    "@khaby.lame",
    "https://www.tiktok.com/@mrbeast"
  ]
}
```

**Competitor or influencer panel**
```json
{
  "profiles": ["nike", "adidas", "newbalance", "puma"],
  "maxVideosPerProfile": 5,
  "proxyConfiguration": {
    "useApifyProxy": true,
    "apifyProxyGroups": ["RESIDENTIAL"]
  }
}
```

**TikTok Shop seller research**

Pass in a list of usernames, then filter the dataset by `is_seller: true` to get only the creators with monetised shops, along with their `commerce_category`.

## Pricing

Pay per result.

| Event | Price |
|---|---|
| Actor start | $0.005 |
| Each profile delivered | $0.0005 |

Some quick math:

- 10 profiles = **$0.010** total
- 100 profiles = **$0.055** total
- 1,000 profiles = **$0.505** total

`recent_videos` is included in the profile row - no extra per-video charge, but expect longer runtimes on runs that hydrate videos.

No monthly fees. No minimum spend. You only pay for profiles the scraper actually returns - if TikTok blocks a profile and we can't recover it, you aren't charged for that profile.

## How to use it from an AI agent

The actor is exposed on Apify's MCP endpoint:

```
https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/tiktok-profile-scraper
```

This works with Claude Desktop, Claude.ai, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain, and any other MCP client.

Example prompt:

> Use tiktok-profile-scraper to get profile data for charlidamelio, khaby.lame, and mrbeast. Show me a table of follower count, bio link, and account age, sorted by follower count.

## Reliability

In a recent 300-profile validation run, the actor delivered **every public TikTok account that actually exists** - 100% success on real accounts. The only failures (~5-6% of any large mixed input) are accounts that don't exist on TikTok at all: typos, deleted accounts, banned accounts, or country-specific handle variants. **Under pay-per-result pricing you only pay for what we deliver, so nonexistent inputs cost you nothing.**

## Caveats

- Only public accounts can be scraped. Private accounts return basic profile fields with `is_private: true` and most stats null. `recent_videos` is never populated for private accounts.
- Nonexistent / deleted / banned accounts are reported as errors and skipped (not charged). Many brand handles have country-specific variants - e.g. `@nintendo` exact-match doesn't exist; their real handle is country-specific.
- `like_count` and `bio` may be `null` even for big accounts - TikTok doesn't always expose those fields in the public payload.
- `recent_videos` is capped at ~10-12 items per profile because that's what TikTok's creator embed surfaces publicly. Requesting more returns whatever the embed provides.
- `play_url` and `duration_seconds` inside `recent_videos` are almost always `null` - TikTok deliberately strips those from public embed pages.
- Avatar URLs are signed and expire after a few months. Re-scrape if you need fresh ones.
- Default proxy is Apify's datacenter pool - TikTok serves the public profile HTML over datacenter just fine at our volumes. Switch to RESIDENTIAL only if a specific run is being degraded.
